title: Create & Conquer Server
description: Is the Server Version of the modpack Create & Conquer
body:
🖥️ Server-Side Instance Only
This package is a dedicated server-side instance of the modpack. Please note the following for a successful setup:

Server Use Only: This instance contains only the necessary server-side mods and configurations. It is not intended to be launched as a playable client.

Performance Optimized: All client-side-only mods (such as Shaders, HUD enhancements, Zoom, or Controller support) have been removed to ensure maximum stability and server performance.

Compatibility: Players must use the standard [Create & Conquer Client Version] to connect to a server running these files.

Deployment: Simply extract the contents into your server's root directory, accept the EULA, and run the start.bat (or your preferred startup script).
